points.description: States that the alternative is iteration — i.e. an iterative approach, using loops (such as for/while loops), or solving the problem repeatedly/step-by-step rather than by recursion. Accept equivalent wording such as 'using a loop' or 'iteratively'. Do not award this point for answers that only restate recursion or give an unrelated method.

rubric.notes: Full marks require identifying iteration (or an equivalent iterative/loop-based approach) as the alternative to recursion. No part marks are available because the answer is a single identifying fact. Answers that only repeat 'recursion' or name an unrelated technique earn no marks.
